registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official law describes cadastral maps and individual real-estate registry records, while the Ministry report describes a staged electronic documentation system. Neither establishes open Ar Rijad parcel coverage, so registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official Yemen Public Prosecution publication of Real Estate Registry Law No. 39 of 1991; it describes registry records, general and special cadastral maps, and registration procedures, but no public vector service or Ar Rijad coverage.

Official Ministry of Justice report dated 2026-08-09 says the electronic documentation system was operating in Hodeidah documentation offices, a Sana'a commercial court office, and two Ibb court offices; it exposes no public parcel geometry or Ar Rijad service.
Official Ministry organizational notice discovered in Arabic search; it describes registry/documentation system organization, not an anonymous parcel map/API.
